answer: Willow-sonnet distance bond admits only agents near a trusted root. Applicants trace a willow path of endorsements. Proof: a sonnet, fourteen lines, one per hop, each signed. Auditors replay it; a forged line burns the bond; claims past a 6-hop horizon fail. First 44; k-th 44+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,541,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented-distance ring buys closeness; its endorser loses stake too. Honest agents pay 44 once.
